dedupe_keys.name: antarctic treaty secretariat environmental impact assessment eia database

description: The EIA database of the Secretariat of the Antarctic Treaty lists the environmental impact assessments that parties to the Environment Protocol have prepared for activities in Antarctica. Users can search by type (initial environmental evaluation, IEE, or comprehensive environmental evaluation, CEE), by season from 1988/1989 to 2026/2027, by party (from Argentina to Venezuela, 35 parties are listed), by topic and by text, and can limit results to entries with attachments. The topics include construction and operation of air facilities, construction and operation of facilities, drilling in ice or rock, field camps, monitoring programmes, national Antarctic programmes, non-governmental expeditions, oil management and salvage, removal and clean-up of facilities, site remediation, tourism, traverses, use of explosives and waste management. The site also offers an EIA map and sits beside the protected areas, inspections and contacts databases. Access is free online; terms are in the site's disclaimer and copyright pages, and no open licence is named on the page read. Caveats: the database records assessments submitted by parties, so detail varies, and the results table loads after a search. Coverage is Antarctica. It supports capacity planning and environmental analysis of polar research stations, runways and fuel systems; there are no related records in the catalogue yet.
